story.title: The girl who dared to dream big
paragraphs_en: There was a girl named Amu who lived in remote small village with her parents. Her father was a peon in the small government run school in their village and her mother was a cleaning lady in the nearby post office.

Amu was bright and inquisitive child. In their village girls were not encouraged to go to school. But her father was different. He encouraged her to study and read. Her father used to get her books to read from the school he worked in. He used to help her read and study at home. But when she was around 7 years old he decided to put her into the school despite all people around them not supporting his idea to put a girl child in the school.

Amu started going to school and she loved studying specially Maths. Her father could see how bright and dedicated she was. Once the Mayor of the area visited the school and announced a scholarship program that whichever child wins the competition and scores maximum will get scholarship fund. Amu started preparing and studying. But in school she got no support as she was the only girl child studying there.

With her hard work, Amu won the scholarship exam and set an example in the entire village. She changed their outlook and she and her father together started guiding the villagers to start sending their daughters to school and educate them. When scholarship cheque was given to Amu by the Mayor she asked him to help the girl education.
The Mayor was impressed by the little girl’s wish and named the fund after her as Amu Education Trust. This was the beginning of new world and opportunities.
